about: R2 (P-230 (7)): the dated fee table, data and never code. Each line cites IRCC's page, quote and date (P-170). Status: Researched (source, date): may change; Sample until the immigration expert confirms (P-171). Sources: the IRCC fee list itself for the study permit, work permit, open work permit holder and visitor extension lines (read 2026-11-03); research_notes/visitor-visa-and-six-combinations-research-2026-11-02.md rows 1a, 1b, 1c; product/screens/W1-baseline/immigration-facts-2026-10-29.md row 19. Each line carries its basis (P-247): per_application (once per application filed), per_person_by_role (each person of the named roles), per_position (not worked out yet), or family_maximum (each person, capped once enough people apply together). A fee change is an edit to this file with its test (tests/check_r2_fee_table.ts, run by CI). Part 2 of R2 moves it into a stored library table frozen with each release (setup S7a, PUT /library/fees).
